lines.zh: 我游得很慢，身上的光把水照出一圈。
lines.en: I swim slowly, and my glow rings the water around me.

lines.zh: 我的光很弱，只够照亮自己的鳍。
lines.en: My light is faint, barely enough to show my own fins.

lines.zh: 四条同伴跟着我，像一串小灯。
lines.en: Four kin trail me like a string of small lamps.

lines.zh: 我游过海沟边缘，光在水里拖出尾巴。
lines.en: I pass the trench edge, my glow trailing behind.

lines.zh: 五十厘米的身子，在深海里不算大。
lines.en: At fifty centimeters, I am not large for the deep.

lines.zh: 我不赶路，深海里没什么可赶的。
lines.en: I do not rush; there is nothing down here to rush for.

lines.zh: 水流推我，我顺着它滑过礁石。
lines.en: The current pushes, and I slide past the reef with it.

lines.zh: 我的光惊起一群小虾，它们散开了。
lines.en: My glow startles a shoal of shrimp, and they scatter.

lines.zh: 我贴着海床走，那里最安静。
lines.en: I keep close to the seabed, where it is quietest.

lines.zh: 前面太黑，我只好让自己再亮一点。
lines.en: Ahead is too dark, so I let myself shine a little more.

lines.zh: 我绕开热泉，那水烫得发光。
lines.en: I skirt the vent, whose water glows with heat.

lines.zh: 同伴暗了一下，又亮起来，是在叫我。
lines.en: A kin dims and brightens again, calling me.

lines.zh: 我游过沉船的影子，光晃在木板上。
lines.en: I pass a wreck's shadow, and my light sways on its planks.

lines.zh: 速度不快，但我从不迷路。
lines.en: I am not fast, but I never lose my way.

lines.zh: 我拐过一个弯，光也跟着弯。
lines.en: I round a bend, and my light bends with me.

lines.zh: 下面太深了，我停在崖边。
lines.en: It's too deep below. I stop at the ledge.

lines.zh: 同伴的光暗了，我游近一些。
lines.en: My companion's light dimmed, so I swim closer.

lines.zh: 我让水流带着走，省些力气。
lines.en: I let the current carry me and save my strength.

lines.zh: 我停在深水中间，光一明一暗。
lines.en: I hang mid-water, my light brightening and fading.

lines.zh: 我喘得很轻，水连波纹都没有。
lines.en: My breathing is slight and does not even ripple the water.

lines.zh: 我把光收小，只留一点在尾尖。
lines.en: I shrink my glow, leaving a dot at my tail tip.

lines.zh: 深海没有声音，只有我自己的心跳。
lines.en: The deep is silent except for my own heartbeat.

lines.zh: 我想起远亲鱿鱼，它们有触手，我没有。
lines.en: I think of my squid cousins, who have arms and I do not.

lines.zh: 我悬着，像一盏没人点的灯。
lines.en: I hang there like a lamp no one lit.

lines.zh: 上面有月光，这里只有我的光。
lines.en: Up there is moonlight; down here is only my glow.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转身，让光洒向海床。
lines.en: I turn slowly and let my light fall on the seabed.

lines.zh: 同伴在我上方，谁都不急着走。
lines.en: My kin hover above, and none of us is in a hurry.

lines.zh: 我在等，等一件永远不会来的事。
lines.en: I wait for a thing that will never come.

lines.zh: 水压很沉，压得我的光有点扁。
lines.en: The pressure is heavy and flattens my glow a little.

lines.zh: 我张嘴，吞下几粒看不见的东西。
lines.en: I open my mouth and swallow a few invisible things.

lines.zh: 我的光有时自己会闪，我控制不住。
lines.en: Sometimes my light flickers on its own; I cannot help it.

lines.zh: 这里太安静，安静得像在梦里。
lines.en: It is so quiet here it feels like a dream.

lines.zh: 你的火把比我还亮，我有点不舒服。
lines.en: Your torch is brighter than I am, and I do not like it.

lines.zh: 我从黑暗里浮上来，看你站在海底。
lines.en: I rise out of the dark and see you standing on the floor.

lines.zh: 你带了水肺，我猜你能待很久。
lines.en: You brought a diving helmet; I guess you can stay long.

lines.zh: 我用光扫了扫你的脸，你没躲。
lines.en: I sweep my light over your face, and you do not flinch.

lines.zh: 你身后全是黑的，我这边有光。
lines.en: All is black behind you; there is light here with me.

lines.zh: 我慢慢靠近，光落在你的护目镜上。
lines.en: I drift closer and my glow lands on your goggles.

lines.zh: 你是第一个看见我发光的人吗？
lines.en: Are you the first person to see me glow?

lines.zh: 我绕着你游，光一圈一圈地转。
lines.en: I swim around you, my light turning circle by circle.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在海床上，比我的光长。
lines.en: Your shadow lies on the seabed, longer than my light.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，你也盯着我，谁都没说话。
lines.en: I watch you, you watch me, and neither of us speaks.

lines.zh: 血散开，把我的光染红了一点。
lines.en: Blood spreads and tints my glow a little red.

lines.zh: 我挨了一下，光猛地闪了三次。
lines.en: I take a hit, and my light flashes three hard times.

lines.zh: 我把光收起来，想让自己消失。
lines.en: I pull my light in, trying to disappear.

lines.zh: 疼的时候，光会不由自主地亮。
lines.en: When it hurts, my light brightens without my will.

lines.zh: 这一下把我打向海床，沙扬起来。
lines.en: The blow drives me to the seabed, kicking up sand.

lines.zh: 我游得很慢，逃不掉。
lines.en: I swim so slowly that I cannot escape.

lines.zh: 我的鳞掉了几片，那些地方不亮了。
lines.en: I lost some scales, and those spots no longer shine.

lines.zh: 谁在水里打我？我什么都看不清。
lines.en: Who struck me in the water? I can see nothing.

lines.zh: 我翻了个身，又费了点劲才正过来。
lines.en: I tip over and need some effort to right myself.

lines.zh: 光越来越弱，我知道这意味着什么。
lines.en: My light fades, and I know what that means.

lines.zh: 你的饵落下来，我的光跟着它晃。
lines.en: Your bait sinks, and my glow wavers with it.

lines.zh: 深海里很少有东西这么香。
lines.en: Few things down here smell so good.

lines.zh: 我知道那根线，可我很久没吃东西了。
lines.en: I know that line, but I have not eaten in a long while.

lines.zh: 我贴近饵，光把钩照得很清楚。
lines.en: I come close, and my light reveals the hook clearly.

lines.zh: 也许是饵，也许只是块肉。
lines.en: Perhaps it is bait; perhaps it is only meat.

lines.zh: 我的拉力很小，你几乎感觉不到。
lines.en: My pull is weak, and you will barely feel it.

lines.zh: 我咬了半口，又把嘴松开。
lines.en: I bite halfway, then let my mouth open again.

lines.zh: 光暴露了我，也暴露了你的钩。
lines.en: My light gives me away, and your hook too.

lines.zh: 我围着它转，转了整整一圈。
lines.en: I circle it once, a full slow turn.

lines.zh: 我慢慢张嘴，深海教会我不急。
lines.en: I open my mouth slowly; the deep taught me patience.

lines.zh: 我撞上你的膝盖，光晃了一下。
lines.en: I bump your knee, and my light jolts.

lines.zh: 水被你的靴子搅浑，我的光变暗。
lines.en: Your boots muddy the water, and my glow dims.

lines.zh: 我擦过你的手臂，鳞片凉凉的。
lines.en: I brush your arm, and my scales feel cold.

lines.zh: 你后退一步，我才发现自己挡了路。
lines.en: You step back, and I realize I was in the way.

lines.zh: 我被水波推得翻了半圈，光乱了。
lines.en: A ripple rolls me half over, and my light scatters.

lines.zh: 桶壁很硬，我在里面转不开身。
lines.en: The bucket wall is hard, and I cannot turn inside.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，两团光叠成一团。
lines.en: We collide, and two glows fold into one.

lines.zh: 你挡住沟口，我只好从上面绕。
lines.en: You block the trench mouth, so I go over the top.

lines.zh: 这一撞很轻，深海的东西都轻。
lines.en: The bump is gentle; everything down here is gentle.

lines.zh: 我贴着你游过去，光扫过你的肩膀。
lines.en: I slip past you, my glow sweeping your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我们两团光并在一起，亮了一倍。
lines.en: Our two glows merge and become twice as bright.

lines.zh: 它用鳍碰我的侧腹，我就懂了。
lines.en: It touches my flank with a fin, and I understand.

lines.zh: 我们慢慢往上升，升到光能到的地方。
lines.en: We rise slowly into the water my light can reach.

lines.zh: 它闪三下，我闪两下，就算说定了。
lines.en: It flashes three times, I flash twice, and it is settled.

lines.zh: 卵沉下去，落在珊瑚的阴影里。
lines.en: The eggs sink and settle in the coral's shadow.

lines.zh: 我们绕着同一块礁石转了半夜。
lines.en: We circle the same reef half the night.

lines.zh: 我的光落在它身上，它的落在我身上。
lines.en: My light rests on it, and its light rests on me.

lines.zh: 深海也会有两条鱼凑在一起的时候。
lines.en: Even the deep has its moments of two fish together.

lines.zh: 它先走，我跟上，慢了半拍。
lines.en: It leaves first, and I follow half a beat late.

lines.zh: 小荧光鱼以后要自己找路。
lines.en: The little glowfish will have to find their own way.

lines.zh: 我叼起一粒沉下的碎肉，光透了过去。
lines.en: I take a sinking scrap, and my light shines through it.

lines.zh: 那东西没什么味道，我还是吞了。
lines.en: It has no taste, and I swallow it anyway.

lines.zh: 我用嘴翻动它，想看看是什么。
lines.en: I turn it with my mouth to see what it is.

lines.zh: 沉船里的东西多半不能吃。
lines.en: Most things in a wreck are not food.

lines.zh: 我衔着一片鳞，游了很久。
lines.en: I carry a loose scale for a long while.

lines.zh: 一块贝壳太重，我咬了两下就放。
lines.en: A shell is too heavy; I bite twice and let go.

lines.zh: 群里的鱼一起下去，又一起上来。
lines.en: The school goes down together and comes up together.

lines.zh: 我把捡到的东西含在嘴里，慢慢嚼。
lines.en: I hold what I find and chew it slowly.

lines.zh: 那枚铁块是冷的，我不喜欢。
lines.en: That iron is cold, and I do not like it.

lines.zh: 深海底有的是掉下来的东西。
lines.en: The deep floor is littered with things that fell.

lines.zh: 一小群虾在光里乱窜，我看见了。
lines.en: A shoal of shrimp darts through my light, and I see it.

lines.zh: 我的光惊动了它，它也暴露了自己。
lines.en: My glow startles it, and it gives itself away.

lines.zh: 那只水母漂得慢，比我还慢。
lines.en: That jellyfish drifts slower than I do.

lines.zh: 我锁定了最边上那只。
lines.en: I fix on the one at the edge of the group.

lines.zh: 深海里食物不多，看见就不能放过。
lines.en: Food is scarce here; what I see I cannot pass up.

lines.zh: 它躲在礁洞里，我的光进不去。
lines.en: It hides in a reef hole where my light cannot reach.

lines.zh: 我慢慢调整方向，正对着它。
lines.en: I adjust slowly until I face it directly.

lines.zh: 同类的光也转向了同一个地方。
lines.en: My kin's glow turns toward the same place.

lines.zh: 我发现了猎物，也发现我暴露了。
lines.en: I find my prey and find that I am found.

lines.zh: 我的光一开始亮，它就开始逃。
lines.en: As soon as my light rises, it begins to flee.

lines.zh: 我从不追，我让它自己漂进嘴里。
lines.en: I never chase; I let it drift into reach.

lines.zh: 我的光变暗，只留瞳孔那一点。
lines.en: I dim, keeping only a pinprick at my eye.

lines.zh: 它每动一下，我就修正一次角度。
lines.en: Every time it moves, I correct my angle once.

lines.zh: 深海教会我，快没有用。
lines.en: The deep taught me that speed is useless.

lines.zh: 我悬在它上方，慢慢降下去。
lines.en: I hang above it and sink slowly down.

lines.zh: 它贴着礁石，我贴着它。
lines.en: It hugs the reef, and I hug it.

lines.zh: 我在等一个不用追的时机。
lines.en: I wait for a moment that needs no chase.

lines.zh: 一圈，两圈，圈子越收越紧。
lines.en: One circle, two, and the ring draws tighter.

lines.zh: 它累了，我还没动。
lines.en: It is tired, and I have not moved yet.

lines.zh: 我的光在它眼里，是它的全部。
lines.en: My light in its eye is everything it sees.

lines.zh: 我咬下去，牙齿细得像沙。
lines.en: I bite, and my teeth are fine as sand.

lines.zh: 它猛地一扭，我的牙反而陷得更深。
lines.en: It wrenches away, and my teeth sink deeper instead.

lines.zh: 我撞它，用整个身体撞。
lines.en: I strike it with the whole of my body.

lines.zh: 这一口只够咬掉一条腿。
lines.en: The bite takes only a single leg.

lines.zh: 我咬你的手指，血在水里散成一缕。
lines.en: I bite your finger, and blood threads through the water.

lines.zh: 我扑过去，光先到了。
lines.en: I lunge, and my light arrives first.

lines.zh: 我咬着不放，身子被拖得打转。
lines.en: I hold on and am dragged in a slow spin.

lines.zh: 我的力气很小，可我很执着。
lines.en: I am weak, but I am stubborn.

lines.zh: 咬完我就沉下去，回到黑暗里。
lines.en: After the bite I sink back into the dark.

lines.zh: 我从来不是猎手，只是饿。
lines.en: I was never a hunter; I was only hungry.

lines.zh: 我在很深的地方亮起来，四周全是黑。
lines.en: I light up far below, surrounded by black.

lines.zh: 我们四条一起，像被谁同时点亮。
lines.en: Four of us together, as if lit at the same moment.

lines.zh: 这里的水压很高，我早已习惯。
lines.en: The pressure here is high, and I am used to it.

lines.zh: 我的光第一次照见的是海床的沙。
lines.en: The first thing my light found was seabed sand.

lines.zh: 从负五十到四十格，都是我的家。
lines.en: From minus fifty to forty, all of it is home.

lines.zh: 一群荧光鱼出现时，海底像有星星。
lines.en: When a school appears, the seabed looks starry.

lines.zh: 我从海沟的阴影里慢慢升上来。
lines.en: I rise slowly out of the trench's shadow.

lines.zh: 同伴的光围着我，我就不怕黑了。
lines.en: With my kin's light around me, I do not fear the dark.

lines.zh: 我出生时，先学会的是怎么发光。
lines.en: When I was born, the first thing I learned was to glow.

lines.zh: 这片深海很安静，我们说话都用光。
lines.en: This deep is quiet, and we speak in light.

lines.zh: 火在水面烧起来，我的光被比下去了。
lines.en: Fire burns on the surface, and my glow is outshone.

lines.zh: 我被摔在礁石上，光一下灭了大半。
lines.en: I am dashed on the reef, and most of my light goes out.

lines.zh: 水太浅了，鳃张着却换不到气。
lines.en: The water is too shallow; my gills work but find no air.

lines.zh: 冲击把我掀到半空，光在黑暗里散开。
lines.en: The blast throws me up, and my light scatters in the dark.

lines.zh: 一道水线穿过我的光，然后才觉得疼。
lines.en: A line cuts through my glow, and only then comes pain.

lines.zh: 有东西钻进我的光里，一点点掐掉它。
lines.en: Something enters my light and pinches it out, bit by bit.

lines.zh: 很久没吃东西了，我的光开始发青。
lines.en: I have not eaten in long, and my glow turns sickly.

lines.zh: 雷劈进水里，我的光炸成了白色。
lines.en: Lightning hits the water, and my glow bursts white.

lines.zh: 水不见了，我往下坠，连光都追不上我。
lines.en: The water is gone; I fall, and even light cannot catch me.
